services.desc: Description > • Never played paintball before? No problem! We offer Low Impact Paintball! This great product is just like the real thing but using a smaller paintball marker and a smaller paintball. What does that mean? Well paintballs hit you with 70% less ouch! The equipment is also light weight making it easy for players of all ages to carry around and use! This is not the "plastic" low quality paintball guns this is the real thing! It's not just for kids either. Players of all ages can enjoy this scaled down version of paintball!
